parties.respondent: Vittal Gurudas Pai Since Deceased By Lrs. & Ors.

summary: Contempt for breach of undertaking not to alienate property; undertaking given 11.07.2007, 13.08.2007, made court order on 17.11.2007; sale deeds executed post-order; High Court held appellants in contempt, imposed attachment, imprisonment, and compensation; SC examines maintainability of Order XXXIX Rule 2A application, validity of injunction, standard of proof, and proportionality of punishment; apology and health considered; challenge to High Court's reversal of trial court's dismissal of contempt plea.
legal_provisions_cited: Civil Procedure Code, 1908 Order XXXIX Rule 2A
Civil Procedure Code, 1908 Order XLIII Rule 1(r)
final_judgment: Pending; judgment extract truncated before final disposition.
